reasons: Candidate applies rate() to a monotonic sum, but the Datadog query is a raw sum:redis.net.commands with no rate function. The quantity becomes a per-second rate instead of the cumulative command count, and the unit changes from {command} to {command}/s.
Candidate uses a fixed range [5m]; only $__rate_interval is allowed as a range.

Template variable $host (prefix host, default *) is dropped. It should become a matcher on the host label (host_name or the observed equivalent). No host label is observed in the dataset for this metric, so the matcher cannot be verified and series selection differs.
The metric redis.commands.processed (monotonic sum, {command}) is a plausible equivalent, so outcome translated is reasonable; $scope is correctly dropped and $key is unused by the query.
